table.retrieve:
SELECT
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	ItemCategory = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemCategory IC WHERE IC.ICatCode=I.ICatCode),
	ItemClass = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemClass IC WHERE IC.ICCode=I.ICCode),
	Manufacturer = (SELECT M.Name FROM Manufacturer M WHERE M.ManfCode=I.ManfCode),
	PCTCode = P.Description,
	SalesTaxSchedule = S.Name,
	Applicable = S.Applicable,
	TaxType = S.TaxType,
	TaxRate = S.TaxPerc,
	Stock = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty) FROM GodownDetail GD WHERE GD.ICode=I.ICode), 0)
FROM
	Item I, PCT P, SalesTaxSchedule S
WHERE
	P.PCTCode IN (:ai_pctcode) AND
	I.PCTCode = P.PCTCode AND 
	I.SalesTaxScheduleCode=S.SalesTaxScheduleCode
